summary: Geometry sweep found a 3x faster crossover config; the exactness gate caught it: the grouped-IMMA path is WRONG at counts>=4. Correctness-first bug filed; fix is the next work item.

evidence.1_owner_profile: dual-backend K56 golden (moe_profile.json): hot8 canonical 1.6055s; gu 71.7% + down 24.2% = 95.9%
evidence.2_geometry_sweep: crossover=0 (all-IMMA block_m=8): 12.94 ms/layer -> 0.557 s/block projection; FULL 43-layer block bench 0.5652 s (T_target 0.668s, R_oracle 42.3/s) — 3.0x faster than c3 baseline
evidence.3_exactness_gate: c0 vs QPA(exact_moe) shared banks: ~100% max diff. Single-expert top-1 weight-1 bisect: M=1,2,3 c3 BITWISE-EXACT (DP4A queue); M>=4 BOTH c0 and c3 ~100% wrong (IMMA queue)
evidence.4_per_gemm_isolation: mxint_imma_gemm and mxint_dp4a_gemm (UNgrouped) bitwise-exact vs reference_fp4_linear_source_semantics at m=1..8 — the bug is in the GROUPED path (mxint_ksplit_grouped) or its driving, not the GEMM math
evidence.5_warp_independence: error identical across imma_k in {2,4,8,16} -> not the K-split warp reduction
evidence.6_uniform_M_exceptions: c0 == c3 bitwise at uniform single-expert M in {3..20} (both equally wrong vs QPA for M>=4; equal to each other)

bug.name: GROUPED_IMMA_TILE_BUG
bug.location: mxint_ksplit_grouped / _imma_grouped_src or emit_tiles interaction, exercised when expert counts > crossover (multi-row IMMA tiles)
bug.never_caught_because: 2.9R validation at K8-mid had mean M ~1.6-2.4 (nearly all assignments rode the DP4A queue); golden-greedy lineage is K1 (counts=1, DP4A, exact). Repro tests only cover k<=4 with e=8 random ids (counts<=2 mostly).
bug.impact_correctness: Any fused_moe_mxint result at K>=~32 with default crossover=3 where counts>3 occur is numerically WRONG. Golden-greedy K1 path unaffected.
bug.impact_timing: Historical MoE timings (1.3923s K56 etc.) remain valid as compute-cost estimates (identical kernels/work, wrong values). WideVerify raw-rate numbers unaffected as timing.
bug.fix_next: debug _imma_grouped_src gu/down at multi-row tiles vs the exact ungrouped GEMM; suspected tile/pad/scatter handling (warp-independent, ~100% scale). After fix: re-run crossover sweep — the 3x all-IMMA speedup may land and clear the 750ms gate (0.565s measured WITH the bug; fixed version to be re-timed).

tests_to_add: fused_moe_mxint vs exact_moe parity at counts>=4 (e.g. single expert, top-1, M in {4..16}, weight=1) — current suite misses this regime.

resolution.root_cause: mxint.py _imma_grouped_src: scale base pointer folded nb*(K/32) into the kt-column offset, so sb[g] advanced the K-column instead of selecting weight row nb+g. g=0 read the correct element (kt+0); g>=1 read a neighboring K-block e8m0 scale -> pow2-ratio output errors.
resolution.fix: base sb at column kt only; loads sb[(nb+g)*(K/32)] / sb[(nb+g+8)*(K/32)]. Applied to both hot8 and packed4 variants. One-line class of change; kernel math otherwise identical to the validated ungrouped kernel.
verification: single expert top-1 weight=1 vs exact_moe: M=1..56 ALL BITWISE-EQ (both c0 and c3)
multi-expert 64 experts, distinct top-6, real weights, uniform+skewed (max M=33): hot8+packed4, c0+c3 ALL BITWISE-EQ
permanent regression suite tests/test_grouped_imma_parity.py: 26 tests; full suite 134 passed
